The package follows common AUR patterns for binary packages, especially those wrapping Electron apps. While it does not include a `prepare()` or `build()` function (as expected for `-bin` packages), and uses `!strip` and `!debug` options (common for prebuilt binaries), none of these choices indicate malicious intent. There is no obfuscated code, no execution of downloaded scripts, and no deviation from standard packaging workflows.
